title: Trunk EMG (%MVE) vs force level (10-50% MVC) in flexion exertions with 1D vs 3D moment feedback, males
condition: static ramp flexion exertion 0-55% MVC, upright standing in triaxial dynamometer; 3D-feedback = coupled moments minimised (pure primary moment), 1D-feedback = primary plane only

quantity.name: normalised EMG RMS
quantity.definition: EMG RMS (250-ms centred window, 30-450 Hz, 130 ms electromechanical delay) at 10/20/30/40/50% of the direction-specific MVC, normalised to MVE = the muscle's peak RMS over all MVC trials in the six directions; group means (no SD plotted); session 1, mean of 5 trials

source.authors: Lariviere C, Gagnon D, Genest K

protocol.summary: Triaxial dynamometer (feet, knees, pelvis stabilised; thorax in a frame on the force platform), upright standing; bilateral Delsys DE-2.3 electrodes: MU-L5 (~3 cm), IL-L3 (~5-6 cm), LO-L1 (~3 cm), RA, EO, IO (McGill 1991); five 5-s ramps 0-55% MVC per feedback condition.
how_to_simulate: Upright standing, pelvis fixed, thorax loaded through a rigid frame; no hand load.

Apply a pure flexion moment at L5/S1 equal to 10,20,30,40,50% of the MVC (Table 1 mean 186±34 Nm, or subject-scaled) - matches the 3D-feedback condition; for 1D add the coupled moments (~2.5-11% MVC at 50%).

Normalise each model muscle's activation by its maximum over simulated MVCs in all six directions; compare activations of muscles under the named electrode sites (left/right separately) with the 3D-feedback means.
protocol.notes: Only curves whose five force levels were separable in the figure were digitised; levels where curves/markers overlapped were omitted (see data). Fig S4 (abdominals); Fig S3 back muscles not digitised (antagonists, ~1-3 %MVE, curves overlap). The paper reports significant FEEDBACK effects mainly in frontal/transverse exertions (Table 2).

extraction.check_notes: Values compared visually with every panel; Fig S10 (axial left) re-digitised independently at 200 dpi: 23 points agree within 0.2 %MVC.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= max(3 %MVC, 20% of mean) (no SD reported); trend with force level must match
